description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for the 'git am' command, specifically testing behavior with corrupt input, missing lines, and NUL byte handling in commit messages. It includes setup functions, test definitions, and checks for expected error conditions.

methods.name: make_mbox_with_nul
methods.description: Creates a mock email patch with optional NUL characters in the subject or body for testing 'git am' handling of such input.
